text: The passions of men must cooperate with their reason in the prosecution of a war. The public may be clearly convinced that a war is just, and yet, until their passions are excited, will carry it languidly on.
author: John Adams
reference: Familiar Letters of John Adams and His Wife Abigail Adams
locator: Letter 176, John Adams to Abigail Adams, Philadelphia, 28 April, 1777
